title.en: Tale 17 — The Owls and the Crows

sentences.ar: كان في عداوة قديمة بين البوم والغربان.
sentences.en: There was an old enmity between the owls and the crows.
Owls see at night, and crows by day.
The owls attacked at night and killed many.

sentences.ar: الغربان اجتمعوا وما عرفوا شو يعملوا.
sentences.en: The crows gathered and did not know what to do.

sentences.ar: غراب كبير وعاقل قال: عندي فكرة.
sentences.en: An old, wise crow said: I have an idea.
But you must pluck my feathers and throw me out.
